```elixir title="Elixir"

result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\",\"stream\":true}") |> Enum.to_list()
```
